## Silver Dragon, Great Wyrm (CR 22)

**XP** 615,000  
 LG Colossal dragon (cold)  
 **Init** +2; **Senses** dragon senses, fog vision; Perception +40; **Aura** cold(10 ft., 2d6 cold), frightful presence (360 ft., DC 32)  

**Defense**

 **AC** 39, touch 0, flat-footed 39 (-2 Dex, +39 natural, -8 size)  
 **hp** 580 (29d12+232)  
 **Fort** +24, **Ref** +16, **Will** +26  
 **Defensive Abilities** reflective scales, true courage; **DR** 20/magic; **Immune** acid, cold, paralysis, sleep; **SR** 33  
 **Weaknesses** vulnerability to fire  

**Offense**

 **Speed** 40 ft., fly 250 ft. (poor); cloudwalking, graceful flight  
 **Melee** bite +36 (4d8+21/19–20), 2 claws +35 (4d6+14), tail slap +33 (4d6+21), 2 wings +33 (2d8+7)  
 **Space** 30 ft.; **Reach** 20 ft. (30 ft. with bite)  
 **Special Attacks** breath weapon (70-ft. cone, DC 32, 24d8 cold), crush (4d8+21, DC 32), paralyzing breath, tail sweep (2d8+21, DC 32)  
 **Spell-Like Abilities** (CL 29th; concentration +37)  

  
  At will—
  *control weather, control winds, detect evil, feather fall, fog cloud, reverse gravity*
  
 **Spells Known** (CL 19th; concentration +27)  

  
  9th (4/day)—
  *gate, true resurrection*
  

  8th (7/day)—
  *greater spell immunity, [holy aura* ](../../magic/spells/holy-aura.md)(DC 26)
